description.value: The Sunshine Coast Arts Council (SCAC) is a volunteer-founded charitable society operating a unique log-constructed arts centre at the corner of Trail and Medusa in Sechelt, with two gallery spaces, a music and visual arts studio, and curated gardens. Founded in 1966, the centre has been a cultural anchor for the Sunshine Coast for over 50 years, hosting rotating exhibitions by regional artists, public programs, craft fairs, and youth art camps. A touring cyclist with an interest in local arts and culture would find an active, community-rooted gallery destination in the heart of Sechelt.
